top_signals.title: HK Dollar Peg Architect Says Narrower Band May Ease Speculation
top_signals.summary: Narrowing the Hong Kong dollar’s trading band against the US greenback may enhance stability and reassure the public if such a move were ever implemented, according to John Greenwood, the economist dubbed the father of the city’s currency peg.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
